facts.summary: Component appearance changes interior artwork only; canonical terminal anchors, saved circuits and electrical results remain unchanged.
componentAppearance is validated and persisted through the settings whitelist, snapshot and equality subscription.
Matter effects consume accepted signals; reduced motion, offscreen and dense-scene suppression remain in effect.
Basic and Pro are interface modes, not membership grants. Premium actions and read-only recovery use the existing access boundary.
Phase 1.7 UI acceptance is separate from the Phase 1.9 full matrix; F.3 performance exceptions remain open.
All phases develop and test locally; no Cloudflare remote actions or publication are implied by local acceptance.
Phone Fault Lab is owned by FaultLabDialog; the new phone Inspector must hide while that dialog is open to avoid duplicate controls and intercepted clicks.

Membership administration has its own Vite entry at /admin/pro/ and uses fresh server-guarded APIs; it does not boot simulator persistence. Multi-entry builds require counting modulepreload chunks in the initial JS budget.
The local browser lifecycle exposed D1 LIKE pattern limits for long emails. The member picker now uses case-insensitive literal instr search, preserving percent and underscore as literal text.
Real-cookie role fixtures are isolated to scripts/browser-test-worker.ts and its local Playwright database. Production src/worker.ts never imports that entrypoint.

Long unbroken benefit names must wrap in headings and records, and form grids must use minmax(0, 1fr). Otherwise mobile document overflow changes hit-testing and can make checkbox clicks land on unrelated fields.

List-effect cleanup only cancels that list request. It must not invalidate the newer access-check generation when focus revalidation changes access to checking; that race leaves the admin screen stuck.

Plan PATCH replaces the complete feature list. The editor must block review until all benefit choices have loaded; an empty loading form must never become an empty replacement. A readonly required input does not enforce this browser validation.
